method: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer' (published 24 May 2023). Every claim is a paraphrase backed by anchors (scripts/anchor.py): verify.py --source re-finds each anchored span in a fresh copy of the source, checks the claim's numbers against it and rejects copying. LICENCE: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read at Europe PMC fullTextXML <license> element for PMC10220270). The source's words are NOT reproduced here.

claims.claim: **Do not restrict HER2 amplification testing to RAS wild-type tumours**; test RAS-mutant disease too where resources and reimbursement allow, and if testing is not funded consider referral to a centre running trials.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Testing HER2 together with RAS, BRAF and dMMR/MSI in one pass saves tumour tissue.**
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **DPD testing (genotype or phenotype) may be considered before a fluoropyrimidine, depending on the population, and should be done after severe fluoropyrimidine toxicity.** The Asian panel softened ESMO's advice because DPD deficiency is rare in Asian patients (about 0.6% in one Japanese series).
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **UGT1A1 genotyping before irinotecan** is advised if UGT1A1 deficiency is suspected (low conjugated bilirubin) or if a dose above 180 mg/m² per administration is planned; the variants raise the risk of severe neutropenia.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Do not deny resection or ablation just because first-line chemotherapy failed.** Reassess for resection once second-line treatment is working; intra-arterial chemotherapy can be a second-line route to response and liver resection.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Local treatment can be the primary or metastasis-directed treatment, or consolidation after systemic therapy.**
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Intra-arterial options (TACE, TARE/SIRT, hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy)** may be used with non-curative intent.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Left-sided, RAS wild-type: anti-EGFR antibody plus doublet chemotherapy.** In a Japanese phase III trial, panitumumab with mFOLFOX6 gave longer overall survival, higher response and more R0 resections than bevacizumab with mFOLFOX6.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Right-sided RAS wild-type tumours gained no survival benefit from panitumumab**, although R0 resection rates were similar with either antibody.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Do not currently combine an anti-EGFR antibody with FOLFOXIRI**: no phase III trial supports it, and a European trial found no gain over FOLFOX plus panitumumab.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **FOLFOXIRI with bevacizumab** is an option only for selected patients in good performance status without comorbidities.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Frail or elderly patients not fit for chemotherapy with unresectable RAS wild-type disease** can be offered panitumumab alone.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **If 5-FU or capecitabine cannot be tolerated because of cardiotoxicity or hand-foot syndrome**, the oral fluoropyrimidine S-1 may be substituted.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **dMMR/MSI disease: first-line pembrolizumab is a standard of care.** Progression-free survival improved; the overall survival difference was not significant, probably because 60% crossed over.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Maintenance means stepping down treatment intensity to reduce side effects** in patients not suitable for surgery or local therapy. First-line FOLFIRI can simply continue to progression if tolerated. On progression during maintenance, re-introduce the induction regimen that worked.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **BRAF V600E-mutated, previously treated: encorafenib with cetuximab is the best second-line option** (and the best third-line option if not used earlier); adding binimetinib is optional where available.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **dMMR/MSI-H progressing after first-line chemotherapy:** ipilimumab with nivolumab is recommended; nivolumab or pembrolizumab alone are alternatives.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Trifluridine–tipiracil, with or without bevacizumab,** is recommended after fluoropyrimidines, oxaliplatin, irinotecan and biologics, or earlier after oxaliplatin and irinotecan failure, subject to local approvals. Adding bevacizumab improved overall and progression-free survival and response in a phase III trial.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **RAS and BRAF wild-type, never given an EGFR antibody:** cetuximab or panitumumab as a single agent.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Fruquintinib is a further option after fluoropyrimidines, oxaliplatin, irinotecan and biologics**; two placebo-controlled trials showed a significant overall survival gain.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **HER2-positive, RAS wild-type, refractory disease:** dual HER2 blockade works (trastuzumab with lapatinib), and tucatinib with trastuzumab is likely to become another option.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **During active treatment, image at least every 12 weeks** (usually CT or MRI) and measure tumour markers. Assess toxicity from systemic treatment and surgery, including in long-term survivors.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with JSMO and Asian oncology societies (Yoshino et al.), ESMO Open 8(3):101558, 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer', published 24 May 2023, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10220270/, retrieved 2026-09-23
